name: Millworks Technologies Limited
about: Millworks Technologies Limited manufactures metal components and assemblies for aerospace, defense, railways, and semiconductor industries. The company offers aerospace product, such as turbochargers components, fuel filter components, and turbine blades and nozzle components; defense includes missile airframe components, guidance system housings, structural brackets and mounts, and hydraulic cylinder parts, levelling and alignment components, mechanical housings, mounting brackets, and support structures used in anti-drone systems; railways vertical products includes train control and rolling stock infrastructure components, braking systems components, door mechanisms and actuators, and pantograph systems components; semiconductor machinery components, including machine base frames, precision brackets and mounts, alignment plates, and equipment housings, fixtures for chip handling, and load testing fixtures. The company also offers build to print and build to spec services, producing parts aligned with customer specifications and functional requirements. The company was incorporated in 2021 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, India.
